lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Sightline\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

places: lib/Service/Purger.php:47 OCP\IAppConfig::deleteKey(): deprecated since Nextcloud 13; use method deleteAppValue of \OCP\IConfig
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 33 to 35. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
lib/Service/Purger.php:47 OCP\IAppConfig::deleteKey(): deprecated since Nextcloud 13; use method deleteAppValue of \OCP\IConfig

1 transaction is opened and closed by hand. The trait TTransactional has atomic() since Nextcloud 24 and atomicRetry() since Nextcloud 27, which repeats a transaction that ran into a deadlock, as the manual recommends.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 3 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 14 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
